messages:
sam: Quick copy pass for the small banner that appears when we route traffic to an alternate model variant to preserve throughput. Want it low-friction, non-alarming, and clear about what users can do next. Drafts below.

sam: Draft 1 (neutral):
`Alternate model in use to preserve throughput. You may notice minor differences in responses. Details · Resubmit`

lina: I like the neutral tone. Suggest `preserve throughput` -> `maintain availability` (less infra-jargon). Also swap `Resubmit` for `Send again` to be more user-facing.

devon: UX: include a tiny chip that shows `Ephemeral` vs `Persistent` so users know whether switching is temporary. Make sure chip color meets contrast.

murali: Accessibility: banner should be role=status and focusable via keyboard when it appears. The `Send again` action needs an aria-describedby pointing to the tooltip text.

sam: New combined draft: 
`Alternate model in use (Ephemeral). An alternate variant is serving requests to maintain availability. You may notice minor output or latency differences. Details · Send again`

lina: Wording nit: repeating "alternate" twice feels clunky. Maybe: `Alternate model in use (Ephemeral). This helps maintain availability. You may notice minor output or latency differences. Details · Send again`
devon: CTA order: put `Details` first, `Send again` second so people read context before taking action. Also tooltip on `Send again`: `Resends your input and may be billed again.` Keep tooltip < 80 chars.
murali: For the details panel header prefer plain question copy: `Why did this happen?` Inside show: cause, start time, whether it's ephemeral/persistent, and whether the original model is available on request.
sam: Localization note: use placeholders for model names and timestamps. Translation keys: `fallback.banner.text`, `fallback.banner.chip`, `fallback.details.header`, `fallback.send.tooltip`, `fallback.hide.label`.
lina: Microcopy for hide action in overflow menu: `Hide for session` not `Dismiss` — it's clearer. Also include toast copy: `Banner hidden for this session. View settings to show again.` Keep toast short for translators.
devon: Telemetry: add `ui.fallback.banner_shown=true|false` and `ui.fallback.hide_action=session|24h|permanent` (if we ever add durations). Also include machine flag `fallback.active=true` in the API response so SDKs can surface native UI.
murali: Accessibility follow-ups: ensure toast is announced by screen readers and does not steal focus. Also add aria-live polite for the banner so it doesn't interrupt a screen reader mid-sentence.
sam: Final engineering copy proposal: 
`Alternate model in use (Ephemeral). This helps maintain availability. You may notice minor output or latency differences. Details · Send again`

sam: Implementation notes: 
- chip values: `Ephemeral` | `Persistent` with accessible color contrast
- `Details` opens panel titled `Why did this happen?` with masked model-variant names and timestamps
- `Send again` shows tooltip: `Resends your input and may be billed again.` (translation key: `fallback.send.tooltip`)
- overflow menu item: `Hide for session` -> toast: `Banner hidden for this session. View settings to re-enable.` (key: `fallback.hide.toast`)
- banner role=status with aria-live=polite, dismissible via keyboard, dismissal persists for session only
- API field: `fallback.active` and `fallback.mode=ephemeral|persistent`

access-bot: Note: include translation context for each key and reserve short fallback english strings. Add a canary deploy to eng-sre and run accessibility smoke tests in staging.

sam: Thanks all  I'll update the copy doc, add keys to the PR, and drop the accessibility checklist into the ticket.
